C-DISCOVERY-SHARED-CARDS.IntentSummary: Execute the user's approved style adoption across Discovery, sequentially in an isolated checkout. Generalize the existing projection and CSS, preserve wording and identities, verify all page families, reconcile affected GRACE state and publish under the standing authorization.

T-001.Title: Generalize the approved presentation for both languages and all page families.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Use source-driven context, group and scenario cards, localized labels and expandable workflow previews with working stage destinations; preserve authored content.

T-002.Title: Verify the complete rollout and correct layout or interaction defects.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: All routes, both themes, desktop/mobile, all source scenarios and stage content, keyboard interaction, search and temporary portable output pass their checks.

T-003.Title: Reconcile durable ownership and evidence, close the change and publish.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Graph and verification describe the adopted patterns, closure records evidence, and the served manifest identifies the clean published source commit. Concurrent wording edits remain unstaged and intact.
